title: How to answer any interview question
subtitle: What to look for in a question you have never seen, and how to build the answer. Twelve questions worked through.

points.head: Look for three things.
points.text: The asks, the kind of answer each one wants, and the narrowing words.

points.head: Build it the same way every time.
points.text: Their words and your answer. One chunk for each ask, in order. Then stop.

points.head: Prepare pieces, not answers.
points.text: The question tells you which pieces to use.

how: Coloured boxes show example words. Grey is a weak answer, green is a strong one, blue is a line to say out loud.
Sam, who gives the full example answers, is made up.
